title: 3 Pcs 14"x14" Nut Milk Bag, Natural Unbleached Cotton Cheese Cloth Bag for Straining, Reusable Strainer Bag for Oat Almond Milk, Cheese Making, Yogurt, Juice, Cold Brew Coffee, Beer Tea (14x14 Inch)
description:
About this item
Ideal Size: The package includes 3 packs of 14” x 14” nut milk bags, perfect for homemade milk and juice filtering needs, simply filter once to enjoy smooth, residue-free beverages every time
100% Natural Cotton: These nut milk bags are crafted from food-grade, pure natural cotton, chemical-Free, odorless and unbleached, offering a healthier choice for your daily use
Efficient Fine Mesh Straining: The nut milk bag features a U-shaped mesh bottom with a drawstring closure, and its fine mesh (100-grade) and optimal weave density ensure quick, efficient filtration without residue or leaks
Durable & Reusable: The stitches of the cheese cloth bags are reinforced, making them durable and not easy to break; they are also easy to clean, store after air-drying, and can be reused many times
Multiple Uses: Our nut milk bags are suitable for making and straining nut/ almond/ soy milk, fruit juice, vegetable juice, soup, yogurt, cold brew coffee, and so on, versatile enough to meet various straining needs

reviews_5s:
I bought these nut bags as part of an interest in making my own plant based milk. Some products are becoming so expensive and the quality has been lacking. The value was great for 3 bags. They are a good size for making average sized recipes. There is a drawstring at the top that can be used for different purposes. It can help tighten the bag around a container. The string can be tied to container whatever is being strained as well. They work best to manage small batches at a time and may become messy if not handled properly. Even so, I have used these bags so far make coconut milk, strain cranberry purée into juicy, and made watermelon juice from a melon that was too ripe for slicing. Everything has come out well and there is little waste. The bags are thin but durable and are meant to be thin. They wash well and pulp comes off easily. One bag has been stained red from cranberry juice but it was expected. I have washed these bags in cold water and air dried them without shrinkage. Overall good product, good value, and may help with food costs and reduce waste. They pay for themselves in just a couple uses.Great for making kava!! It also has some other practical uses!! I'm going to buy more!Easy to clean, easy to store. Perfect for reuse.Not only made well, but we have already used them and they worked very well!!!Really good to extract the extra juice from the pulp💯I originally got this to filter seeds out of my smoothies but they proved too thick for the mesh. Not at all the fault of the cheese cloth though, this works great to filter liquid out from solids. Cleans pretty easily and is very easy to use, just load it up and squeeze.These were great and did just the job. Used them for a big cooking event, they wash great and work great. Can’t recommend them enough.I’ve been using cheesecloth/nut milk bags for over a decade at this point. It’s a common part of life when you’re vegan. These bags are by far the best I’ve used.

These bags don’t have the odd smell that a lot of cheesecloth does until you wash it a few times. That’s huge given that you’re using these for food.

These are easily secured around the top of a wide mouth jar and the fabric is fine enough to retain the fiber yet allows for easy flow, reducing the need to squeeze.

I’ve used these for oats, pumpkin seeds, cashews, almonds, and hemp seeds, and it worked great with all of them.Linen Yogurt Straining Bag
I was searching through linen products and found these. I had no idea that they even existed. I’d been using long strips of cheesecloth from a big box store to strain my yogurt. It was such a pain. Discovering these made my day.

The size is perfect for me to stand two of them up side by side and fill with a whole thing of yogurt made in my pressure cooker. (I use a full gallon of milk when I make yogurt.) This did strain much quicker than my previous cheesecloth. I ended up letting it drain over night and that was too much. I’ll be sure to shorten my straining time in the future.

These were very easy to clean. I rinsed them in the sink and then put them into a lingerie bag to run through the washing machine. I air dried them. I really like that these are bags and not long strips as cloth as it makes them easy to use, clean and store! They simply fold up and go into the drawer. I also feel that the price is well worth the quality and quantity received. I am very pleased with this product and would order again in the future.I have never used a nut bag before. These are way better than cheese cloth though. I wasn't aware that they don't drain real well on their own as they are very tightly woven which makes them superior to cheesecloth when making milk. I had to squeeze the bag to get the milk out. The milk was very smooth and creamy. Very nice result. The pulp ends up being fairly dry and easy to shake out and use in another recipe. The bag rinsed and cleaned up easily. I'm sure with some practice I will get the squeezing technique down better. The price for three is very reasonable.
